supplemental.historical: Tree capacity power of two, minimum one. Arrays have 2*size slots; value null and position -1. Optional crossing history allocated before timestamp extraction. Fill leaves before parents.

Leaf insertion original order, Decimal helper normalizes Low then High. Parents descend and preserve selected child's position. Null left selects right even if right null; if left nonnull, null right selects left, else min<=/max>= chooses left on ordinary equal values.

Suffix validity four inclusive adjacent guards; no shrink, no extension past existing capacity. Valid first==new length no-op; clear history only if first<old length-1. Replace time suffix in place, update length then leaves then parents; no explicit rollback within helper.
Public first_less/greater select strict semantics via ge/le exclusion. Range extrema use nonempty half-open bounds and explicit min/max selector. No global normalization of query levels in wrappers.

Range query rejects invalid bounds, decomposes segments left then right. Value eligibility precedes missing best, directional improvement, equality then earlier-position tie. Best positions preserve source order despite segment traversal order. No eligible result raises.
First crossing differs from extrema query: left clamped upward, right downward, empty returns null; no history => direct, otherwise history.

History key excludes right bound; key includes left, level, exclusion callable. Existing settled hit only returned when <right. New hit before last position persists; latest position still returned but not cached as settled. No-hit coverage advances only to min(right,length-1). OrderedDict assignment retains insertion order for existing keys; cap 16384 FIFO not LRU.

Root null/excluded shortcut. Left nodes tested immediately, right nodes deferred and reversed. First eligible node descends left unless excluded, then right. Only root has explicit null check; native ge/le and source tree assumptions govern internal calls; arbitrary callbacks not certified.
Prepared path identity validation before register, overrides cache if valid. Normal cache uses id plus source identity; no explicit freshness check. New index defaults history off.
Reflected index retains base and aliases same time list. First crossing methods swap direction with sign-copy threshold; range queries swap min/max and sign-copy result, preserve positions.
Clear all three global maps or pop each requested identity key, no mutation of still-referenced index/view instances. Explicit invalidation, not proof of safe arbitrary source mutation.

limitations: Source-group semantic review and row-role linkage, not execution of every expression or unique rule count. Native comparators and valid tree/input alignment assumed where source requires them.
No global consumer, arbitrary external callback or mutable source safety proof.

findings.meaning: Make RE41/RE42 distinguish native cache key equality (including numeric equality of Decimal representations) from string geometry keys in RE59, and insertion FIFO from LRU. Latest row is returned but never cached as settled crossing.
RE43/44 ordering is positional; internal node predicates lack null guard and right child not separately tested. State native tree assumptions; no arbitrary callback or timestamps-sorted guarantee.

Direct refresh helper has nontransactional mutations. Verify all dirty frontiers, prepared windows, global registry lifetimes and outer rollback boundaries during B02 and B09/B10; no guarantee of external alias rollback.
